name: KFin Technologies Ltd

ledger.quote: We are hopeful by end of the year, we will cross 10,000 mark and be the largest registrar by a mile.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised crossing 10,000 corporate clients by end of 2025, but no updated total was reported.

ledger.quote: I expect that to happen most likely in the next 12 to 14 months.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised mutual fund industry reaching $1 trillion by Sep 2026, but management did not provide updates.

ledger.quote: I'd like to believe that in the next 3 to 4 quarters, we should start seeing decent EBITDA contribution
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised decent EBITDA contribution from NPS in 3-4 quarters; NPS achieved roughly 15% plus EBITDA contribution.
ledger.evidence: It is no longer a loss-making, but adds to about roughly 15% plus in terms of the EBITDA.

ledger.quote: we maintain an EBITDA margin of 41.5% which is in the range of guidance that we gave of 40% to 45%.
ledger.speaker: Vivek Mathur
ledger.verdict: Promised EBITDA margin of 40-45% for FY26; full year FY26 OPM reached 41.0%.

ledger.quote: I do not anticipate any further yield compression.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: I think we will cross INR2 trillion by the next time I speak easily.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised crossing INR 2 trillion AIF by Feb 2026, but no update was given on execution.

ledger.quote: and one that we are confident we will get close to 50% into the next 12 to 18 months.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised 50% AIF market share by May 2027; current market share stands at 37.3%.
ledger.evidence: Our total consolidated count of the funds today is roughly around 731, and it occupies a share of about 37.3%.

ledger.quote: And we have a very strong plan -- operating plan to get into double-digit margins into the next year.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised double-digit margins for Ascent by next year; currently at 8.4% EBITDA margin.
ledger.evidence: This year, too, it continues to be around 8.4% in terms of the EBITDA margin, and we believe that in quarters to come, we would expand that.

ledger.quote: And it is our intent and the stated commitment that we want as we grow other businesses much faster, would be able to reduce an overreliance on one asset class and one geography under 50% into the next couple of years.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.target: reduce reliance on one asset class and geography under 50%
ledger.verdict: Promised reducing single asset class and geography dependency under 50%; timeframe remains pending until FY28.
ledger.evidence: We do believe that the fast outperformance of each of these businesses would mean the dependency on a singular business will come down to below 50% into the coming three years and if not, sooner.

ledger.quote: And as the acquisition of Ascent as we drive forward international expansion, I'm very confident that we will be in the top 3 into the next 5 years in terms of the total quantum of investors, volume of transactions as we handle
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised top 3 ranking in investors and transactions within 5 years; target timeframe remains pending.

ledger.quote: So whilst you do not see Ascent numbers kind of meeting KFintech's into immediate future, but it is definitely a 3-year plan, thus we believe we can get that far.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised Ascent margins matching KFintech in 3 years; target remains pending over a 3-5 year period.
ledger.evidence: coming to EBITDA margin of KFin Tech level, it will take about three to five years.

ledger.quote: We believe that we'll continue to maintain that guidance going forward as well.
ledger.speaker: Vivek Mathur
ledger.verdict: Promised 15-20% revenue growth and 40-45% EBITDA margins; achieved 19.25% revenue growth and 41% OPM in FY26.

ledger.quote: We aim to cross -- we aim to get to close to 11,500 into this upcoming year
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised 11,500 corporate clients by FY27; timeframe remains pending.

ledger.quote: organic revenue to grow a little over 60% plus into this year
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised over 60% organic international revenue growth in FY27; Q1 organic growth stood at 32%.
ledger.evidence: Even if you exclude Ascent, just the KFin’s organic business has grown over 32%.

ledger.quote: overall international revenue to be a little over 70%, including that of Ascent
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised 70% overall international revenue growth for FY27; Q1 international growth reached nearly 200% year-on-year.
ledger.evidence: In terms of international business, obviously with the Ascent’s expansion, we have grown nearly 200% year-on-year.

ledger.quote: EBITDA, we expect it to be around 16% to 17% and a PAT little around 10% growth is what we expect to see into the coming year.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised 16-17% EBITDA and 10% PAT growth for FY27; management upgraded expectations to 17-20% and 12-15%.
ledger.evidence: we have visibility for EBITDA growth closer to 20%, anywhere between 17% to 20%, and our PAT numbers anywhere between 12% to 15%.

ledger.quote: organically, we believe we have line of visibility to grow close to about 15% and the PAT a little over 11%.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Promised 15% organic revenue growth and 11% PAT growth in FY27; guidance maintained at 18-20% total revenue.
ledger.evidence: the crux of the call today is that we continue to maintain the trajectory of growth on the revenue in the range of 18% to 20%.

open.quote: We do believe that the fast outperformance of each of these businesses would mean the dependency on a singular business will come down to below 50% into the coming three years and if not, sooner.
open.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella

open.quote: We do believe that into the Q2, notwithstanding, we are working towards hoping to hit double-digit margin expansion by end of year, and subsequently, depending upon the pipeline that we have, continue to add at least finite basis points every single year from there on
open.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella

open.quote: We will maintain 40% threshold including Ascent by the end of this year.
open.speaker: Vivek Mathur

open.quote: EBITDA margins will be in the range of 40% to 45%.
open.speaker: Vivek Mathur

read: Management demonstrates strong execution on broad financial metrics, meeting FY26 margin guidance and successfully turning the NPS business profitable. However, management often stays silent on specific operational volume targets once the promised timeframes elapse.
questions: Did KFintech cross the target of 10,000 corporate clients by the end of calendar year 2025?
Has the domestic mutual fund industry reached the $1 trillion AUM target expected by September 2026?
What specific steps are being taken to arrest the 2% yield compression observed in Q1 FY27?
bull: FY26 revenue grew 19.25% to Rs 1301 crore with OPM of 41.0%, meeting core guidance.
NPS business broke even and now contributes over 15% to total EBITDA.
Q1 FY27 international revenue expanded nearly 200% YoY following the integration of Ascent.
bear: Yield compressed by 2% in Q1 FY27 due to client asset mix shifts toward liquid funds.
Ascent EBITDA margin remains low at 8.4%, diluting overall consolidated margins to 34.2% in Q1.
Management failed to update progress on promised milestones like 10,000 corporate clients and $1T MF AUM.
